title: agalma hoi
intro: Agalma hoi, commonly known as the "Sea Dragon Fruit", is a type of marine plant that belongs to the family Dictyotaceae. The health benefits of Agalma hoi include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Agalma hoi include its ability to modulate the immune system, protect against oxidative stress, and promote tissue regeneration. The bioactive constituents of Agalma hoi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
